hypothesis.text: class of VQAs may constrain ratio of leakage through initial state.

citations.quote: The class of VQAs we consider here restricts the initial state ρ to be a stabilizer state, the observable O to be a sum of poly(n) Pauli stings O = P i ciPi with real coefficients ci, and the circuit U (φφφ) to consist only of the constant Clifford gates and parametric Pauli rotation gates e−ıPk φk /2.

citations.quote: For short swap and hold lengths, we can see that the ratio of leakage to computational error depends on the initial state, with higher states producing more leakage error as expected.
